# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU rendering and Linux font discovery fixes. It also aligns .NET 11 and WASM native assets, adds Tizen 10 native builds, and updates platform build support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and incorporates the current main-line engine cleanup. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208), [#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering and pixel scaling** — Adds native GPU rendering and pixel-scaling support for GTK4 applications. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — Restores system-font discovery for Linux applications using the NoDependencies package variant. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **Tizen 10 native builds added** — Adds GCC 14.2 native build and packaging support for Tizen 10. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Aligns HarfBuzzSharp native assets with the .NET 11, Windows, and Tizen platform build updates.
